title:
PPL Strength and Growth
Blueprint
desc: This novice-friendly training program is designed to help you gain strength. Perfect for those with some experience in lifting, this program has easy-to-follow workouts that gradually increase in intensity, making sure that you see progress without feeling overwhelmed.

ex.note: Triceps Pushdown (Superset with Bodyweight Dips)
Keep elbows slightly forward, focus on squeezing lats at the bottom.
Keep the torso stable, drive the elbow back for full contraction.
Keep your chest up, retract the scapula before pulling.
Keep body glued to the pad, avoid using momentum.
Keep arms slightly bent, stretch lats fully before pulling dumbbell back up.
Keep elbows behind torso, full stretch on each rep.
Keep elbows close to the body, squeeze at the top.
Keep core tight, push knees out, and drive through heels.
Keep a slight knee bend, push hips back, and stretch hamstrings.
Control the weight, squeeze at the top for 1-2 seconds.
Hold at the top for 1-2 seconds, get a full stretch at the bottom.
Slight bend in elbows, squeeze chest at the top for 1-2 seconds.
Lower bar to upper chest, control the movement (2s down, 1s up).
Keep core tight, pull bar to lower stomach, squeeze lats.
Keep arms straight, pull rope/bar towards thighs, slow controlled reps.
Keep chest against the pad, pull elbows back, avoid using momentum.
Keep back against the pad, lower the bar to just below chin level.
Keep slight bend in the elbow, raise arm to shoulder height.
Lift with control, avoid using momentum.
Step forward for a slight stretch in the bicep at the start.
Keep elbows tucked, control the lowering phase
Keep wrists neutral, focus on the brachialis & forearm engagement.
Keep elbows stationary, fully extend arms.
Keep elbows close to the body, fully extend at the bottom.
